input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user, role. The platform provides capabilities for user, security, security. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
As a User, I want to use security capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use security capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
